name: HC28a: Total Eligible
description:
Number of pregnant or breastfeeding women who are active on ART and eligible for the 3-monthly viral load monitoring schedule during the reporting period.
The patient must have started ART, must be active on ART through an ART encounter during the reporting period or return_visit_date > :endDate, and the latest ART-card assessment on or before :endDate must indicate pregnancy or breastfeeding. Unlike HC27, eligibility is not tied to exactly three months after ART initiation; this indicator represents ongoing 3-monthly PMTCT viral load monitoring.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.encounter_date <= :endDate

  AND (
      (
          a.encounter_date >= :startDate
          AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
      )
      OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
      WHERE s.patient_id = a.patient_id
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
      WHERE r.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL
        AND r.art_start_date <= :endDate
  )

  AND (
      FIND_IN_SET(
          'PREGNANT',
          REPLACE(a.pregnancy_status, ', ', ',')
      ) > 0
      OR FIND_IN_SET(
          'Breast feeding',
          REPLACE(a.pregnancy_status, ', ', ',')
      ) > 0
  )

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND x.encounter_date > a.encounter_date
        AND x.encounter_date <= :endDate
  );
